26773.overview:
Abobo's Big Adventure is a parody tribute to well-known and loved games of the NES era. Players control Abobo, an enemy from the Double Dragon games. After Abobo's son Aboboy gets kidnapped Double Dragon-style, he has to battle through a number of levels inspired by NES games. The player will need to adapt to the change of rules in each level: from beat-'em-up to shoot-'em-up (or, for the lack of a better term, avoid-'em-up), from overhead adventure to face-to-face brawl and so on. The game introduces characters, level themes, sprites and SFX from many NES games including Double Dragon, Super Mario Bros., The Legend of Zelda, Kung Fu, Radical Ninja, Jaws, Donkey Kong, Dig Dug, Balloon Fight, Castlevania, Megaman, Darkwing Duck, Dr. Mario, Blaster Master, Contra, TMNT, Kirby's Adventure, Ninja Gaiden, Punch-Out and others.

While the rules of the game change with every level, one feature stays the same: for successful disposal of a number of enemies in a row, Abobo will increase his Rage meter. When the meter fills up, Abobo will unleash his ultimate attack, which is unique for each level.

27545.overview: Agar.io is a web browser-based game where the player must increase the size of of their own circular cell by engulfing other player’s cells. The game is notable for its simple addictive gameplay. It gets its name from Agar, a substance found in cell walls of certain algae.

90823.overview: While staying on the coast in Ducan Creek with Dr.Gregor MacDermoth and his daughter Ophelia, Prescott Bridgeman receives a letter from his old landlord Mary Miller telling him about the mysterious disappearance of her tenant Dr.Alvin Carter after his stay in her Victorian estate near where Prescott is staying. Prescott and his friends decide to do an investigation there, since they find that the problem doesn’t only lie in the disappearance, but also there is something mysterious around and inside the estate. That’s where the game begins, with Prescott as the players’ character.

145385.overview: While Prescott goes to meet Alica Blackwood, Ophelia attends the international violin contest at London Coliseum. She does so well at the contest that her performance impresses everyone in the hall; including Baron Vongaburg - who kindly invites her to her manor for dinner the next day. As Ophelia retreats to her dressing room, a disconcerting vision suddenly hits her mind. Sensing something weird is going on round the room, Ophelia sets out to investigate...

203378.overview:
A game which you can play when you idle, and when you don’t.

Gain some EXP, level up. Unlock many awesome features. Earn over 600 achievements. Climb the leaderboards. Brag to many friends, and even people you don’t know.

Features endless gameplay and a lot of imaginary goals to achieve!

This game is constantly updated with new stuff from player ideas!

215948.overview:
This flash version of Alien Hominid spawned the many console versions later released. This version only features the first level, but still has the same style of play and story where a little yellow alien is shot down by the F.B.I. and must defend himself against their onslaught.

The controls consist of using the Left and Right arrow key to move Hominid while use the Up key to jump and shoot upwards and using the Down key to shoot downwards while jumping. To shoot Hominid's gun, the player uses the "A" key while using the "S" key to jump.

The player advances through the level, shooting at F.B.I. agents or slicing them at close range with a knife. Additionally, the player can jump on top of enemies and bite their heads off and can find various power-ups scattered throughout the level that includes shooting fire from their gun and larger energy balls.

Graphic artist Dan Paladin is responsible for the hand drawn art for the game and later did the work for the console releases and has done other games such as Sack Smash 2001, Dad 'n Me and Chainsaw the Children.

422567.overview: AOOA, or The Phone, is an adventure game made by Michael Clague.

422568.overview:
Alter is a puzzle platformer developed by Pixelante and published on Armor Games on 2009.

Planets collide and our intrepid little hero finds himself with the power to grow and shrink the world around him. Will he use his new power for good or evil? Will he be AWESOME or like-totally-super-lame? Can you get all four different endings?

422569.overview:
Antbuster is a Flash game developed by RStein and published on Armor Games on January 5, 2008.

The premise of this game is that the player has to use cannons into a picnic field to stop the ants that are trying to steal the cake. The player can upgrade their cannons with over 50 different types and try different combinations to stop the ants.

422575.overview:
Alice is Dead: Chapter 1 is a short point-and-click adventure game based on Lewis Carroll's novel Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.

The player character wakes up in a rabbit hole next to a decomposing Alice, having no memory who he is. The purpose of the game is to get the protagonist out of the hole and discover his identity by interacting with the environment, using items found in the environment or combining those items.

422576.overview:
Humanity is at a turning point. Infinite energy crystals have been found on another planet and you have to fight to take control of it.

Unlock weapons and maps as you progress to expand the game as you play.

422577.overview:
Age of War is a simple strategy game where the player has to defeat the CPU by upgrading their military units through different ages of the human history, starting at pre-historic and going all the way to futuristic.

The player receives money for defeating enemy units and can use that money to buy units and towers. Each age has 3 main units, those being an infantry, a ranged unit and a heavy unit. The player can also choose between 3 defensive towers per age, but has a limited space for them which can be increased by buying. Lastly, each age has a special power that normally consists on destroying many enemy units at once and has a long cooldown, though it costs no money. Killing enemy units also give the player EXP, which is used to get to the next age.

Game ends when the player destroys the CPU's base and vice-versia.

422578.overview: The Animator vs Animation Game came out in 2007 when Animator vs. Animation got popular on the internet. The game idea was created by Alan Becker and developed by Charles Yeh.

422580.overview: You are a hungry spider. Create webbing to catch bugs, before of course... eating them.

422581.overview: Arcuz is an RPG where you (the hero) save Arcuz Village from a mysterious disaster relating to the disappearance of the landlord who owns the land. You must engage in quests to find out about disappearing villagers and the monsters outside of the village.

422582.overview:
Make your place in the history of Arkandia.
Thrown head first into the raging conflict between heaven and hell you must choose a side and forever change the fate of the world.
Delve into deep dungeons and emerge with a pack full of loot, defend the kingdom with the help of your personal companions or spend your time by the forge crafting artifacts of great power.

The Arkandian Legends are a series of stories that you the player live through. Achievements, skills, items and victories in one story follow you through to the next, unlocking new features and advantages as you go.
Your actions will determine the course of your adventures and the choices you make can change the very nature of the world.

422583.overview:
Armed with Wings introduces a world with a grey sky and black walls where living silhouettes are born from Blackmist, and dissipate into blackmist when they die. Here, a tyrant rules an empire, and has killed all who had rebelled against him. 5 years after that victory, one of the rebels he had killed returns to life, with the strength of a hero, and the spirit of an eagle. This is the protagonist of the series.

In the quest for vengeance against the King, Vandheer Lorde, who killed Lone Warrior and his fellow rebels, Lone Warrior have the aid of an eagle spirit he can release from within himself to move and retrieve objects, or distract his foes while he sneak up behind.

While progressing through the stages, Lone Warrior fights various soldiers and monsters in the service of Vandheer Lorde, including a powerful monster that acts as the first boss in the series. Eventually, the Lone Warrior meets Vandheer Lorde and fights him. He manages to defeat him, but Vandheer Lorde vows revenge and flees.

422584.overview: Enjoy an exciting graphic adventure! Observe everything around you and think of a survival strategy. Gather resources, food, artisanal weapons, build defense walls and manage to survive as many days as possible. Each decision will lead you to a different result. Good luck and survive!

422586.overview:
Achievement Unlocked is a game that centers around meta-gaming, as in, the gameplay isn't what matters in this game, instead, it's all about the achievements. As a parody of games which incorporate achievements which reward players for doing certain actions for a certain period of time/certain number of times, in Achievement Unlocked players will have to do just that, by finding and unlocking all of the achievements.

The player controls a blue elephant which can be move to the left and right, and jump with the arrow keys. There are a total of 100 achievements to unlock, but the charm of the game consists of finding all of them, by exploring the level and trying out different commands.

422590.overview: First Ambitiion game, a serie of choose-your-own-adventure games developed by ZapDramatic. It has 10 games in the series.

422591.overview:
Amorphous is a top-down combat game developed by Innoculous Games.  It entails a nameless swordsman fighting against an army of gelatinous monsters known as Glooples.

This game also has a remastered version called Amorphous+, which has achievements and unlockable power-ups in addition to all the content found in the original Amorphous.

422595.overview: In this action packed multi level game you have to help A.L.I.A.S (Artificial Life-form Intended for Assassination & Sabotage) escape the secret laboratory where he was created. You must help him battle his way through the army base and blast all the soldiers and obstacles with his high fire rate gun. Use W,A,S & D to move around and then when you need to aim and fire you can do so by using the mouse. Each kill restores a bit of health and also power-ups help for that as well.

422602.overview:
Amateur Surgeon is the first game from the Amateur Surgeon series, developed by Mediatonic Ltd. and published by Adult Swim. Amateur Surgeon is a surgery simulation game. Though the game is no longer active on its host site, its levels are fully functional in Amateur Surgeon 4: Re-Generations.

The game follows the adventures of Dr. Alan Probe, a pizza boy and wannabe surgeon, and Dr. Bleed, a disgraced surgeon, who tries to commit suicide by walking in front of Alan's pizza van. Afterwards they work together to heal unlikely patients as a murderous mystery lurks in the city.

422603.overview:
Ano's Energizer is a puzzle-logic game where player controls Acno. Hero has to move balls into the "energizer" in limited amount of time in order to complete level.

There are various enemies that kill Acno once touched. Enemies can be killed by pushing various objects (rocks, barrels) onto them. Several levels also include locked door, that can be opened by grabbing yellow key.

There are 35 levels and each of level can be accessed from "Enter Levelcode" - every level has a specific code that is displayed before level starts. There is also a level editor that allows player to place any object that appears in the game - create his own puzzle. Time limit can also be set. Level can be saved only after player completes test game on it.

422641.overview:
After centuries of peace and isolation, the Sky Fortress of the Whistle Knights has been found! It's up to you to defend against the invading forces of mankind, with only your bow to help.

In this game, the player has to buy and level up weapons and other gear that can be combined to create custom loadouts.

422849.overview:
A Duck Has An Adventure is an unique hypercomic adventure game that challenges you to discover all the different possible lives one duck could live. From adventures on the high seas to the halls of academia and beyond, every choice you make builds a new pathway along which to explore.

16 unique endings to discover! 12 achievements to unlock! And 7 hats to collect! Yes! Hats! Wooo!

443911.overview: Play AdventureQuest to explore an online RPG and other games for free. New adventures every week.

451409.overview:
A Small Favor is a short point-and-click adventure game set in a distant alien galaxy. The player controls a nameless assassin who takes on the assignment to kill a prominent senator. In order to get to this politician, he will have to get past a few closed or guarded doors. In traditional adventure-style, this is done by manipulating the environment using found objects, and, since the main protagonist is a professional killer, eliminating people. The dialogue is fairly minimal however.

Besides the main quest, there are also some side quests, referred to as "favors". Bringing those to a good end, adds to the player's end score.

465882.overview: Play as Spider-Man and swing across the  rooftops of Manhattan to stop criminals and recover stolen items. Use Spider-Man’s fast, acrobatic combat and signature moves to defeat enemies and protect the city.

482463.overview: A Flash remake of Achtung, die Kurve! for competitive play on a shared screen. Each player steers a continuously growing trail, avoiding the borders and everyone else's lines to be the last survivor.
